name: Beta Decomposition
definition: A post-training analysis technique that separates a Deformable Beta Splatting scene into distinct geometric frequency bands and diffuse/specular lighting components by leveraging the Beta Kernel's parameterization.
summary: Beta Decomposition separates Deformable Beta Splatting scenes into geometric frequency bands and diffuse or specular lighting components, a capability absent in standard Gaussian Splatting.
